ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft / Ricochet Chollima) HWP exploit spawning interpreters — RokRat / DOGCALL delivery chain
ucs.description: Hunts the signature APT37 initial-access chain where a weaponised Hangul Word Processor (.hwp) document — the actor's preferred lure for South Korean defectors, journalists, and human-rights NGOs — exploits HWP/EPS rendering and spawns LOLBin interpreters that stage RokRat, DOGCALL, KARAE, or Chinotto. Hwp.exe spawning powershell/mshta/cmd is effectively never benign in non-Korean enterprise estates, and even in Korean estates is a high-fidelity weaponised-document signal.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="hwp.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "hwp.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","forfiles.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildPath  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName == "hwp.exe"
| where ChildName in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft HWP Document Spawning Interpreter / LOLBin
id: 5f1e8b2c-6d9a-4a3f-9c2b-1e7f8a4c2d3b
status: experimental
description: Detects Hangul Word Processor (hwp.exe) spawning PowerShell, cmd, mshta, wscript/cscript, rundll32, regsvr32, certutil, or bitsadmin. Characteristic of APT37 (ScarCruft / Ricochet Chollima / Reaper / InkySquid / Group123) weaponised HWP lures delivering RokRat, DOGCALL, KARAE, or Chinotto against South Korean and defector targets.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/group123-goes-wild/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\hwp.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Internal Korean-language document macros that legitimately shell out (rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\hwp.exe OR *\\Hwp.exe OR *\\HWP.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^hwp\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|curl)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Hwp.exe is the Hangul Word Processor — South Korean office software with virtually zero install base outside DPRK-adjacent targeting. APT37 has weaponised HWP/EPS objects (CVE-2017-8291, CVE-2018-0802 chains, embedded EPS PostScript) consistently across the Group123 / RokRat / DOGCALL / KARAE / GoldBackdoor campaigns going back to 2017. Hwp.exe is not designed to shell out — any child interpreter

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 RokRat / DOGCALL / Chinotto C2 via legitimate cloud-storage APIs (Dropbox / pCloud / Yandex Cloud / Box)
ucs.description: Hunts non-browser / non-sync-client processes contacting api.dropboxapi.com, api.pcloud.com, cloud-api.yandex.net, or api.box.com — the signature dead-drop / bidirectional C2 channel APT37's RokRat backdoor (and its DOGCALL / Chinotto / GoldBackdoor cousins) has used since 2017 to blend C2 into TLS-encrypted traffic to allow-listed SaaS providers.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as urls values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agents from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.dest IN ("api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","api.box.com","upload.box.com") by Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.app | `drop_dm_object_name("Web")` | search NOT app IN ("Dropbox","DbxSvc","pCloud","Yandex.Disk","Box","BoxSync","chrome","msedge","firefox","iexplore","brave","opera","safari") | where count < 50 | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic([
    "api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com",
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","p-srv.pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com",
    "api.box.com","upload.box.com"
]);
let LegitClients = dynamic([
    "dropbox.exe","dbxsvc.exe","pcloud.exe","yandex.disk.exe",
    "box.exe","box sync.exe","boxedge.exe",
    "chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "brave.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemoteUrl in~ (CloudC2Hosts) or RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (LegitClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), Hits = count(),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
             InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteUrl
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic([
    "api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com",
    "api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com",
    "cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com",
    "api.box.com","upload.box.com"
]);
let Baseline = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where DstHostname in~ (CloudC2Hosts)
    | summarize by SrcHostname, DstHostname;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DstHostname in~ (CloudC2Hosts)
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on SrcHostname, DstHostname
| where HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Dropbox" and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "pCloud"
     and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Yandex"  and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Box"
     and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "Mozilla"
| project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr,
          DstHostname, Url, UA = HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 RokRat Cloud Storage API C2 (Dropbox / pCloud / Yandex / Box)
id: 8d2e7b4c-9f6a-4c1d-b2e5-3a8f9d1c4b7e
status: experimental
description: Non-browser, non-sync-client processes resolving or connecting to Dropbox, pCloud, Yandex Cloud, or Box API endpoints. Signature C2 channel used by APT37's RokRat, DOGCALL, Chinotto, and GoldBackdoor implants since 2017.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/rokrat-reloaded/
  - https://www.volexity.com/blog/2021/08/17/north-korean-bluelight-special-inkysquid-deploys-rokrat/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1102.001
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    DestinationHostname:
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'api.pcloud.com'
      - 'eapi.pcloud.com'
      - 'cloud-api.yandex.net'
      - 'webdav.yandex.com'
      - 'api.box.com'
      - 'upload.box.com'
  filter_sync_clients:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\Dropbox.exe'
      - '\DbxSvc.exe'
      - '\pCloud.exe'
      - '\Yandex.Disk.exe'
      - '\Box.exe'
      - '\Box Sync.exe'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
  condition: selection and not (filter_sync_clients or filter_browsers)
falsepositives:
  - Internal scripts using cloud-storage SDKs for backup or telemetry
  - Third-party file-sync utilities not in the legitimate-client list
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.dropboxapi.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.com OR api.box.com OR upload.box.com) -@Image:(*\\Dropbox.exe OR *\\dropbox.exe OR *\\DbxSvc.exe OR *\\pCloud.exe OR *\\pcloud.exe OR *\\Yandex.Disk.exe OR *\\Box.exe OR *\\Box\ Sync.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\Chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\iexplore.exe OR *\\brave.exe OR *\\opera.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.dropboxapi\.com|content\.dropboxapi\.com|api\.pcloud\.com|eapi\.pcloud\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.com|api\.box\.com|upload\.box\.com)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(Dropbox|DbxSvc|pCloud|Yandex\.Disk|Box|Box Sync|chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave|opera)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count < 50
ucs.rationale: Use of legitimate cloud-storage APIs as a bidirectional C2 transport is RokRat's defining behaviour — public Talos, Volexity (InkySquid), Kaspersky (ScarCruft), and Mandiant (TEMP.Reaper) reporting all repeatedly tie this exact tradecraft set (Dropbox + pCloud + Yandex + Box token-based C2) to APT37. Most other APTs that abuse SaaS lean on Google Drive, OneDrive, GitHub, or Telegram — the pCloud +
